summary: The land mine kills the mounted rothe. C calls dismount_steed(DISMOUNT_POLY), lands the hero, and after the explosion moves the saddle onto the steed corpse; the JavaScript traps path skipped both source behaviors. The first RNG mismatch is in landing_spot(), followed by a saddle-location screen mismatch.

source.branch: In steedintrap(), C calls dismount_steed(DISMOUNT_POLY) after a trap kills the steed and returns Trap_Killed_Mon. Later in trapeffect_landmine(), if the steed died and has a saddle, C calls keep_saddle_with_steedcorpse(steed_mid, fobj, saddle) after the explosion. JavaScript had note_unported placeholders at both call sites; the existing dismount implementation and the new whole helper now perform those effects.
callers: trap.c:trapeffect_landmine() -> steedintrap() for the mounted hero land mine; steedintrap() -> steed.c:dismount_steed(DISMOUNT_POLY) when the steed dies
trap.c:trapeffect_landmine() -> keep_saddle_with_steedcorpse(steed_mid, fobj, saddle) after blow_up_landmine()

evidence: nethack-c/upstream/src/trap.c:3140-3151: steedintrap() handles LANDMINE with thitm(), then calls dismount_steed(DISMOUNT_POLY) after the steed is killed.
js/trap_effects.js:1435-1466: the LANDMINE branch computes the same steed hit, but its killed-steed arm calls note_unported() instead of invoking dismount_steed().
js/steed.js:877-965: dismount_steed() implements DISMOUNT_POLY and the common release/landing path used by the C caller.
challenges/cases/v67/v67-landmine-steed-saddle-action5.recipe.session.json: the independent Knight setup creates a low-HP saddled rothe, places an actual land mine beneath it, and steps onto it.

challenges/evaluations/admission-979a3f3967638748dc19cf8b6ea8851736ade63e-v67.json: saved baseline has 393/489 screens, 2635/2668 RNG calls, and 446/489 cursors matched; first RNG mismatch is step 392 at landing_spot(), followed by the screen mismatch at step 393.

nethack-c/upstream/src/trap.c:939-963: keep_saddle_with_steedcorpse() searches floor objects and nested contents for the corpse whose OMONST m_id matches the dead steed, then relocates and stacks the saddle at the corpse location.

js/trap_effects.js:3593-3697: trapeffect_landmine() calls the new keep_saddle_with_steedcorpse() after blow_up_landmine(); the helper uses the C floor objlist and object-location/extract/place/stack operations.
